title: Cover photography: Unfinished Music No 2: Life With The Lions by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1968
content:
The cover photograph for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s second album, Unfinished Music No 2: Life With The Lions, was taken on 23 November 1968.

The shoot took place in Room 1 of Second West Ward at Queen Charlotte’s Hospital in London. Ono had been admitted to the hospital on 4 November suffering from pregnancy complications and stress. Lennon stayed by her side throughout her stay, which ended on 24 November.

Ono had a miscarriage on 21 November. The unborn child was named John Ono Lennon II, and was buried by the couple in a secret location.

On this day, Susan Wood photographed the couple, the first in a series of shoots of Lennon and Ono over the coming weeks. One of the shots captured them watching television, with Ono in bed and Lennon on an inflatable mattress on the floor. It was used on the cover of Unfinished Music No 2: Life With The Lions, which was released in May 1969.
